newsitem.title: UK: Independent, AMEC in property lease deal.
newsitem.headline: Independent, AMEC in property lease deal.

text.p: Independent Insurance Company Limited has agreed an option to buy 215 year leases on properties at a greenfield site in north-west England for a maximum 18 million stg with AMEC Developments Limited.

It said that under the deal, if it decided not to exercise the option, it would find a third party buyer of the leases and would itself take a market rent lease of 25 years with a tenant's option to break after 15 yeras.
Development of the property is expected to be finished by February 1998.
Independent will provide financial facilities to AMEC to fund the development cost subject to interest at seven percent.
The property covers around 85,000 square feet.

Independent Insurance Company Limited is a subsidiary of Independent Insurance Group Plc while AMEC Developments Limited is a unit of construction, engineering and facilities management group AMEC Plc.
